rounds.text: Twenty First Century Management Services Ltd demonstrates extraordinary top-line momentum over the medium term, evidenced by a compounded sales growth of 63% over 5 years [E13] and a solid 3-year compounded sales growth of 13% [E14], outperforming baseline historical stagnation. This top-line expansion is accompanied by accelerating earnings growth [E52], pointing to improving operational leverage that the current market capitalisation of ₹ 39.8 Cr fails to price in [E2]. Furthermore, the stock trades at an exceptionally modest P/B multiple of 0.95x against a staggering sector benchmark of 7.62x [E6], alongside a P/E of 0x compared to the sector benchmark of 35.85x [E5]. Even on filed statements, the price-to-book sits at an accessible 1.73x on a book value of ₹ 21.9 with the share price at ₹ 37.8 [E1], while resting merely 28% up its 52-week range [E4] and leaving substantial room for multiple expansion.
